> 絕聖棄智，民利百倍；絕仁棄義，民復孝慈；絕巧棄利，盜賊無有.

Chapter 18 was the diagnosis: benevolence is praised because the ground under it has cracked. Chapter 19 is the prescription, and it is the bluntest passage in the book.

Three 絕, then a turn: 此三者以為文，不足. Then the positive instruction: 故令有所屬 — give it somewhere to belong. 見素抱樸，少私寡欲，絕學無憂.

The structure is: break first, build after; and breaking is not enough.

## What 絕 does and does not mean

絕 is to cut off, to remove from a position. It is not 砸 — it does not mean smash the thing.

The object of the three 絕 is not the person who is wise, benevolent, or skillful. It is the signboard: the promotion, the ranking, the moral currency that the virtue has been converted into.

- 絕聖棄智 — take the title of "sage" and the currency of "cleverness" off the market.
- 絕仁棄義 — stop trading in benevolence and righteousness as credentials.
- 絕巧棄利 — stop pricing cunning and profit as achievements.

Read as "destroy wisdom, destroy kindness," the chapter is absurd. Read as "take the signboard down," it is the same argument as chapter 3: the standard manufactures the competition it then claims to reward.

## Why 文 is not enough

> 此三者以為文，不足.

文 is the outward pattern — the form, the decor, the articulated rule. The three removals, if they remain only removals, are still 文: a negative rule is still a rule, and a rule that says "don't value X" has already put X in the center of attention.

This is the most modern sentence in the chapter. Prohibition preserves the object. A campaign against a metric keeps the metric in everyone's mind.

So the chapter immediately supplies the positive side.

## 令有所屬

> 故令有所屬：見素抱樸，少私寡欲.

Give it somewhere to belong. 屬 is attachment, the place a thing is anchored.

見素: 素 is undyed silk — the material before the pattern is applied. 抱樸: 樸 is unworked timber — the log before the carpenter. Together they say: let the material be the reference, not the finish.

少私寡欲 is not asceticism. 少 and 寡 are comparative, not absolute: fewer private calculations, fewer acquired wants. The movement is a reduction, not an elimination.

## 絕學無憂

The last phrase is usually detached and quoted as anti-intellectualism. In place, it belongs to the same argument: the 學 being cut is the 學 that produces 文 — learning as the acquisition of ranked positions, the study that makes you comparable.

Not "stop learning." Stop learning in the mode that turns knowledge into a credential. Which is chapter 20's opening line, and its subject.

## The order that matters

Break the signboard, and if you stop there, you have only swapped one 文 for another. The prescription is incomplete until something is put in the place where the signboard was: the unworked material, the smaller self, the learning that is not for ranking.
